note: D-115 / D-116: the controller map. A physical pad's 14 digital buttons can be given to other game inputs, and the two triggers, and the two sticks, can be exchanged; the runtime (tools/r3hd_padmap.h, installed by tools/r3hd_padmap_patch.py) applies the map in the SDK's InputSystem to physical pads only, before every device of a player is merged, so keyboard keys (config/controls/keymap.json) never change with it. The map is always a bijection within each kind: a button chosen for an action that another input used swaps the two, so every game input stays reachable; a trigger only takes a trigger and a stick only a stick (analog values move whole, never become button presses). Ids of buttons are the keymap's pad inputs; bit and vk are the SDK's X_INPUT_GAMEPAD_* and VirtualKey kXInputPad* values (tools/r3hd_padmap_regression.py ties all three). Labels: Xbox name / PlayStation (DualSense) name of the same position (SDL reports a DualSense by position).
actions_note: The actions the Settings window lists: game controls verified by a run or a person (RE_NOTES 'Controller inputs the title uses', E-274 and E-277). Human verification supersedes the incomplete E-274 observation for LB / L1 (health bar without a power-up) and RB / R1 (Grimace, unlocked after Reflux in Desert of the Knaaren). D-120: human verification establishes Y as held Look Mode and B as Roll / Back. Back, D-pad left / right and both stick presses remain uncharacterised and unlisted; they still take part in swaps.
not_assignable: The Guide / PS button and the DualSense touchpad are not inputs of the game on PC and are never assigned; per-device profiles (one map serves every pad). The developer-only XInput backend (input_backend=xinput) is a physical driver and goes through the same map, but play.ps1 always uses SDL and only SDL is tested.
